description: Use this when the user is still choosing a destination or an area to stay in. Returns how many hotels we score, the average Comfort Score, median price, where its hotels beat and trail the average hotel, the best neighbourhoods with their top hotel, and which travel styles it suits. A request for hotels (e.g. 'quiet hotels in Bangkok') is search_hotels' job. Read-only, no sign-in.

checkin.description: User's check-in date, YYYY-MM-DD (e.g. 2027-03-12), if given: links then open on this stay.
